currentRoundInspection.scope: Principal connected Boyana Church exterior: stone western annex, taller brick middle bay with south exterior stair/raised door, lower eastern church with rounded apse and curved roof crown, red ceramic gables and octagonal tiled drum/cap/cross. Arched blind brickwork is raised framing over closed wall, with narrow dark window proxies. Upper door has an actual shallow recess, jambs, soffit, threshold and supported landing. Unseen northern/eastern elevations, internal subdivisions are conservative reconstructions. No fresco copies, furnished interior, garden monuments or surrounding buildings.
